preheader: Also: Reps’ panel to submit power sector reform report next week · 3 stories, 0 risk alerts

overview.text: The House of Representatives has given four polytechnics a fresh deadline to respond to a financial probe.
A House of Representatives panel is set to submit its power sector reform report next week.
The House of Representatives has ordered the suspension of a cancellation of admissions at the National Technical Institute (NTI) and directed a probe of the ministry involved.
